description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.5, §5.7): boulders dam the Millrace above Millford and the mill stands still (Reeve Tamsin asks; the quest also starts within 120 m of the dam). Smash them aside - a stage-4 giant can: 100 XP and Millford's thanks (1 iron).

stages.objective: Smash the boulders damming the Millrace
stages.waiting_text: The boulders will not budge for a giant below stage 4.
